scope.statement: This complete-publication oracle inventories the public NCSC Cyber Essentials Plus Test Specification v3.2. It is not a complete inventory of the current operational Cyber Essentials Plus scheme, Delivery Partner methodology, or certification process.

rights.publication_basis: Reuse of public-sector information from the UK National Cyber Security Centre follows Open Government Licence v3.0.
restrictions: Exclude photographs, images, infographics, and other third-party material unless separately licensed.
Exclude logos, certification marks, trade marks, crests, and other protected branding.
Do not imply official status, affiliation, approval, certification, or endorsement by a source party.
Do not extend the licence to third-party content or content under another arrangement.
Preserve the source attribution and Open Government Licence link when covered information is reused.

known_anomalies.treatment: Recorded without correction or expansion; the publication itself presents only Test cases 1 through 5.

assurance_limits.scope_boundary: The inventory is complete only for the pinned public NCSC PDF, not for the operational scheme or another publication.
assurance_limits.population_and_sample_boundary: Results apply to the tested populations and samples and do not establish assurance for every untested device, account, service, or configuration.
assurance_limits.assessment_date_boundary: Assessment outcomes reflect the conditions examined on the assessment date rather than later conditions.
assurance_limits.evidence_date_boundary: Evidence supports only the period and conditions it records and does not establish later implementation state.
assurance_limits.tool_and_provenance_boundary: Results depend on the approved tools, methods, source evidence, and provenance used for the assessment.
assurance_limits.point_in_time_boundary: A result or certificate is sampled point-in-time assurance rather than continuous assurance.

predicates.meaning: a marginal deviation in less than 5% of performed tests
no evidence of wider failure of Applicant cybersecurity processes
